pa.s: ion The source rock potential of selected bulk samples and picked lithologies from the Cretaceous and Jurassic intervals of the 6608/10-7 well was evaluated by TOC content determination and Rock-Eval pyrolysis. All of the cuttings samples were extracted with methanol/water mixture prior to analysis in an attempt to remove mud-derived polyglycols from the sam

mprising claystones and carbonaceous claystones/coals, were submitted for source rock screening. The claystones generally have poor source rock potential, with TOC contents ranging from 0,97 to 2,19% and S2 yields between 0,82 and 2,05 mg/g, although the core sample from 2043,22m MDRT has fair source rock potential (TOC 4,10%, S2 4,30 mg/g).
